items.title: Larry Ridley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 10, 2003
items.q: And that’s why I feel so blessed that I had the opportunity to come up playing with all those guys.

ctx.x: Lester Young was beautiful. And to see Lester Young, Harry Edison and Vic Dickinson get together and Papa Jo Jones, those guys could talk man, and you wouldn’t know what the hell they were talking about. They had their own esoteric language. They could talk to each other and you wouldn’t know a word of what they’re talking about. And that’s why I feel so blessed that I had the opportunity to come up playing with all those guys. I mean and Joe Venuti and oh man, well if people go to the web site, I’ve got all the…
You’ve been through the list, it’s great.
